title: Ad filtering follows the blocklist
summary:
A focused fix for ad selection, with tighter audio model limits and sturdier diagnostics.

Fixed ad selection so blocked referrers are excluded rather than triggering ads.

Reduced the maximum input for `openai-audio` from 5,000 to 2,000 characters and set both `gpt-4o-mini-audio-preview` token limits to 512.

Error-response logging now handles message collections without a `reduce` method. Image-parameter debugging and a token-validation performance test were added.
